title: JavaScript Fundamentals for Beginners
description: Master core JavaScript concepts including variables, data types, functions, and control flow.

sections.title: 1. Variables & Scope
sections.content: JavaScript supports var, let, and const for variable declaration. Prefer const by default and let for reassignable variables.

sections.title: 2. Functions & Arrow Expressions
sections.content: Functions can be declared using function keyword or ES6 arrow syntax: const add = (a, b) => a + b;

sections.title: 3. Objects & Arrays
sections.content: Arrays store ordered collections, and objects store key-value pairs.

title: React.js Modern Web Development
description: Build interactive single page applications using React component architecture and hooks.

sections.title: 1. Components & JSX
sections.content: React components are reusable building blocks written in JSX syntax.

sections.title: 2. Managing State with useState
sections.content: State allows components to preserve user interactions and render dynamic content.

sections.title: 3. Data Fetching with useEffect
sections.content: Side effects such as API calls and subscriptions are handled inside the useEffect hook.

title: Node.js & Express REST API Architecture
description: Learn to design, build, and deploy production-ready RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express.

sections.title: 1. Express Server Setup
sections.content: Set up an Express server with CORS, JSON parsing middleware, and route modules.

sections.title: 2. Controller & Service Pattern
sections.content: Separate routing logic from business logic using controllers and services.
